$$ビューティ$$
「Then, back to what we were talking about earlier...」

$$レイカ$$
「Hey, what's the parallel world's $$万丈$$ like? Of course, the one next to him was me, right?」

294:t_10:31.en:
$$ビューティ$$
「What are you saying, $$レイカ$$! It's obviously me!」

294:t_10:34.en:
$$ＡＧ$$

294:t_10:35.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「In that world, $$万丈$$ runs a private detective agency in a sea city floating in Tokyo Bay.」

294:t_10:37.en:
$$レイカ$$
「A private detective... In that case, his partner would be me, the $$ＩＣＰＯ$$ prep school student, right?」

294:t_10:39.en:
$$トッポ$$
「...Looks like this is going to be a long one, Big Bro $$万丈$$.」

294:t_10:40.en:
$$万丈$$
「It does. Then let's take care of That Thing ourselves.」

294:t_10:41.en:
$$トッポ$$
「Now you're talking! ...All right, let's give it our all again today!」

294:t_10:43.en:
$$トッポ$$
「...You were fired up, Big Bro $$万丈$$.」

294:t_10:44.en:
$$万丈$$
「I'm particular about my catchphrases, after all.」

295:t_000:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「$$ＺＯＮＥ$$... That thing really jerked us around.」

295:t_000:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「But during the $$時空修復|lc$$ at $$アクシズ$$, the power of the one on Earth came in handy.」

295:t_000:2.en:
$$シャア$$
「So it depends on how you use it. This $$ＺＯＮＥ$$, and the power we hold as well.」

295:t_000:3.en:
$$勝平$$
「Lately Captain $$クワトロ$$... he's been acting kind of cool, hasn't he? Don't you think so, $$ワッ太$$?」

295:t_000:4.en:
$$クェス$$
「It's not Captain, it's Colonel! Get it through your head already, $$勝平$$!」

295:t_000:5.en:
$$柿小路$$
「Ah, it's no use, $$クェス$$. $$勝平$$ is the type who won't remember even when you tell him.」

295:t_000:7.en:
$$シャア$$
「It seems you thought the same thing I did, $$マリーダ$$.」

295:t_000:8.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Yes, Colonel. I think $$クェス$$ and $$勝平$$ are alike in how childish they are, in a good way.」

295:t_000:9.en:
$$クェス$$
「That's so mean! Both the Colonel and $$マリーダ$$!」

295:t_000:10.en:
$$勝平$$
「What are you saying, Sis $$クェス$$! Does it bug you that much to be like me!?」

295:t_000:11.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「You pick fights right away like that, which is why people call you a kid.」

295:t_000:12.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Let's get started on investigating the $$ＺＯＮＥ$$ soon. We don't have time to play around.」

295:t_000:14.en:
$$勝平$$
「Tch... He's so relaxed about everything. Does a person really change this much just from changing their hairstyle?」

295:t_000:15.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That's what being an adult is.」

295:t_000:16.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「You'll understand the Colonel eventually, $$勝平$$.」

295:t_000:17.en:
$$勝平$$
「Yeah, yeah. I'm just a brat, sorry~.」

295:t_000:19.en:
$$恵子$$
「$$ワッ太$$ and $$正太郎$$ are younger than $$勝平$$, and they still know what they have to do.」

295:t_000:20.en:
$$勝平$$
「Then what about Big Bro $n, who sortied alone?」

295:t_000:22.en:
$$セツコ$$
「In $n's own way, $n seems to have something in mind.」

295:t_000:25.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...I'm sorry. Lately I feel anxious a lot less often than I used to.」

295:t_000:27.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Maybe it's because you helped me become more positive, $n...」

295:t_000:28.en:
$n
「If that's the case, then that's fine with me.」

295:t_000:29.en:
$$アルト$$
(Lately, between $n and Miss $$スズネ$$... I can't tell which one is the guardian anymore.)

295:t_000:30.en:
$$甲児$$
(Yeah... Somehow Miss $$スズネ$$ seems to be leaning on $n.)

295:t_000:31.en:
$$ノリコ$$
(Lonely that the Volunteer Club members grew up a step ahead of you?)

295:t_000:34.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Are you two brats like $$勝平$$, too!? Quit playing around and get to work!」

295:t_000:36.en:
$$ルカ$$
「Everyone, be careful! Something is coming!」

295:t_000:37.en:
$$スズネ$$
「This is... the $$サイデリアル$$!」

295:t_001:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「So they've come to greet us as we approach the $$地球圏$$.」

295:t_001:1.en:
$$隼人$$
「Or maybe they intend to use Mars's $$ＺＯＮＥ$$ to extract $$次元力$$.」

295:t_001:2.en:
$$尸刻$$
「There is no need to use such a thing.」

295:t_001:3.en:
$$ノノ$$
「There you are, Cool $$ビューティ$$!」

295:t_001:4.en:
$$チコ$$
「That makes it sound like a compliment, $$ノノ$$!」

295:t_001:5.en:
$$尸刻$$
「First, I sincerely commend you for making it back to the $$地球圏$$ alive. You seem to cling to life even more than I imagined.」

295:t_001:7.en:
$$グラハム$$
「We didn't go through hell for nothing.」

295:t_001:8.en:
$$ランド$$
「If that lady is here, $$尸空#pilot$$ must be somewhere close too...!」

295:t_001:11.en:
$$尸刻$$
「...Understood. Not that this is done as an afterthought, but I will be your opponent.」

295:t_001:13.en:
$$アマタ$$
「What do you mean by that!?」

295:t_001:14.en:
$$尸刻$$
「There is no need for me to answer. It is a trifling matter that has nothing to do with you.」

295:t_001:15.en:
$$アルト$$
「Damn...! You're as emotionless as our captain!」

295:t_001:16.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「I won't go easy on you just because you're a woman, not if you're one of the $$サイデリアル$$!」

295:t_001:17.en:
$$尸刻$$
「If you are able to stir the hearts of me and $$尸空#pilot$$, that is something to be glad of.」

295:t_001:20.en:
$$尸刻$$
「...It seems I have said too much that was unnecessary. Now, let us begin.」

295:t_001:22.en:
$$ブライト$$
「All units, deploy! We'll meet the $$サイデリアル$$ head-on!」

295:t_001:23.en:
$$ランド$$
「Let's go, Crab Lady! I'll beat you down and drag that $$尸空#pilot$$ bastard out!」
